mentions.name: Extra Virgin Vault
mentions.description: An olive oil tracking site with a searchable database of producers and oils, highlighting freshness and helping people find high quality, fresh olive oil produced near them. Enthusiasts can look up specific chemistry, cultivars, and similar oils.
mentions.problem: Freshness is king in olive oil, and people have difficulty finding high quality, fresh olive oil produced near them.
mentions.audience: People looking to buy high quality, fresh olive oil, including producers and olive oil enthusiasts
mentions.source_excerpt: Continuing to build my olive oil tracking site (https://www.extravirginvault.com/) and pipeline. Freshness is king in the world of olive oil, and I hope to highlight to people they can find high quality, fresh olive oil produced near them.
mentions.author: kingo55
